measurement.aggregation: Median and sample CV over all seven raw samples, without filtering or wrapper subtraction

comparison.reason: Previous run includes JIT and covers only native free calls; this run measures the complete AOT/C++ scope and native class regressions
comparison.target_ratio: AOT/C++ < 2 using complete measured workload or batch time

benchmark_context.algorithms_cpp: GN Release flags; FP contraction disabled; stable_sort
benchmark_context.aot_codegen: LLVM O3; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots

validation.release_regression: python -m tools.vl test release all: passed

limitations: AOT steady execution only; no JIT performance samples were executed
Per-call values divide full batch time, including loop, checksum and amortized runtime entry/exit
AOT uses the existing generic CPU target and safety contracts; C++ references and benchmark inputs are unchanged
Class semantic cases without an equivalent C++ baseline are regressions, not C++ ratio targets
All samples are retained in medians and CVs; high-variation cases are listed in variation without discarding outliers
Before/after values are from the preserved compatible workload subsets; no whole-suite comparison is claimed
